question: Does the pinned MPI method-3 candidate rank order change native 512-rank OpenFOAM solver timing relative to method-3 identity order when source, Scotch partition, initialized fields, allocation, runtime, and solver work are matched?

execution_authority.authorization_context: Owner separately authorized use of remaining CPU grant before 2026-10-30; this design is not an admission or reservation.

qualification_gate.current_status_at_design: 25956623 reviewed failure: post-MPI CPU mask expands to0–255 for all512ranks; candidate never launched
qualification_gate.required_terminal_outcome: PBS Exit 0, payload seals intact, identity and candidate MPI world-rank placement validators pass all strict topology/core/NUMA gates, candidate exact assignment matches pinned hashes
qualification_gate.failed_or_ambiguous_result_action: Do not start any solver A/B. Preserve the diagnostic and diagnose its failed subcheck.
qualification_gate.required_future_qualification: A separately sealed affinity and exact MPI mapping qualification must pass; repeat strict mapping on the actual solver allocation. No previous diagnostic satisfies this gate.

candidate_assignment.proxy_caveat: Face counts are graph proxies, not bytes, traffic, memory locality, runtime, or speedup.

stages_once_before_any_solver: verify frozen case source hashes and all eight known shared mesh member hashes
validate exact processor0 through processor511, total 65334765 cells, and actual partition graph identity against pinned graph
common_preparation.parallel_preparation_rank_order: method-3 identity order on observed current-allocation slots
common_preparation.seal_after_initialization: complete hash inventory of all zero-time processor fields; expected retained inventory reference is 3072 files and about 1.717 GB

arm_construction.pair_order: AB then BA; identity and candidate each occupy the first position once
arm_construction.case_origin: four distinct case copies made only after the common initialized baseline passes all gates
arm_construction.copy_policy: Copy-on-write reflink only with filesystem support and distinct inodes; otherwise ordinary full copy after checking scratch capacity. Never hard-link mutable case files.
arm_construction.input_seal_gate: Each arm's full zero-time field seal and immutable case input hashes must equal the common baseline immediately before solver launch.
arm_construction.output_isolation: Each arm has its own case tree, solver log, function-object output, timer output, force output, lifecycle record, and validation JSON.
arm_construction.post_solver_gate: Reseal each arm's zero-time fields and confirm no zero-time mutation; leave solver-generated time directories/postProcessing isolated per arm.

mpi_and_runtime_controls.candidate_order_file: render pinned candidate assignment against actual identity probe slots on this allocation; rank zero remains in first slot
mpi_and_runtime_controls.order_display: MPICH_RANK_REORDER_DISPLAY=1 and retain output for all preparation and solver launches

transport.all_other_effective_FI_variables: inherited after one module setup, captured and required identical across arms

mpi_and_runtime_controls.other_inherited_environment: Capture and compare module list, OpenFOAM version/precision, Cray MPICH/PALS versions, compiler, launcher, linked MPI libraries, relevant MPICH variables, and relevant WM variables. Explicitly unset or reject conflicting MPICH_RANK_ORDER.
mpi_and_runtime_controls.per_allocation_mapping_gate: Before each arm, rerun identity and candidate MPI placement probes under the exact arm launcher, binding, and order-file settings. Require four allocated hosts, 128 unique physical cores per host, strict expected physical NUMA-domain counts, and every MPI_COMM_WORLD rank at the intended host/core/NUMA identity slot. Any unprovable component stops before that solver arm.
mpi_and_runtime_controls.diagnostic_probe_scope: Startup mapping evidence only; not solver-time CPU residency or memory page placement.

solver_work_and_validation.outlier_policy: Preserve and include every sample; no trim, downweight, warm-up run, shortened endpoint, or quiet retry.
required_per_run_checks: OpenFOAM 2512 double precision and native End without fatal/MPI failure
512 ranks on four native hosts with 128 ranks per host
Times 1 through 150 exactly once and fixed iteration counts at every step
149 positive finite solver-log and time-function samples with exact time-index and accumulated-time agreement
150 finite force-coefficient rows matching solver times
full mean, median, linear p95, maximum/time, IQR diagnostics, all raw samples, force outputs, and run logs retained
solver_work_and_validation.cross_arm_numerics: Report per-time force/output differences. Rank reordering may change floating-point reduction order. Do not require bitwise-identical final fields or claim numerical equivalence absent a separately preregistered tolerance.

resource_plan.estimate_basis: One prior confirmation wrapper 1133.66 s including one 549.16 s solver, plus three additional solver runs at the same 549.16 s each; excludes extra arm copies, per-arm probes, and expanded validation.
resource_plan.scratch_copy_note: Approximate 1.717 GB initialized zero-field inventory per copy times four arms; mesh, logs, output, baseline, and filesystem metadata add space. Verify actual quota and free space before copying.
resource_plan.accounting_note: Allowance is the request-time core-hour ceiling, not posted billing. Final PBS accounting and actual charge require separate review.

telemetry_and_claim_limits.comparison_summary: Report all four run distributions and both paired A-minus-B block differences. Time steps are serially correlated; do not treat 298 samples per treatment as independent replications or compute an independent confidence interval from them.
telemetry_and_claim_limits.claim_scope: One allocation can test an allocation-specific effect of the validated MPI rank ordering under matched controls. It cannot alone establish general speedup, causal bottleneck, cross-allocation stability, or contest acceptance.
